dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-contrast light perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to dark interiors, clustered predominantly on the upper-left anterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters situated in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli, with highest concentration near the dorsal midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the upper-left flank define a scalene quadrilateral with an interior angle of approximately 120 degrees at the topmost vertex.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex reticulated network of high-contrast lines connects multiple annuli, creating a continuous mosaic-like pattern across the dorsal-lateral surface.
